description: Spec 015's registered study (2026-11-13): spec 014's quantities decided again with the repaired evidence (prior version 3), one edge-aware rule for a history's identity, a reference held where it drifts and a refit control with a fall-back. man2.what: Annex B's manoeuvre statistics (the search's prior is right)
